summary: This document pertains to the quick entry system designed for placing students into programs. It includes fields for student information, placement request details, and service contact details, among others. The page also includes functionalities for maintaining placement requests and validating input data, with errors and messages being displayed when validations fail.
purpose: Facilitate the entry of placements requests for students into specified programs and tracking relevant details.

workflows.name: Placement Request Workflow
steps: Print or view the placement request

business_rules: If group size is one and not a group type, and one student assigned, treat as enrollment PR with group size null.
Hide NIS checkbox if user is not NIS administrator and program isn't an NIS participant.
Site and service are required fields.
validations: Program, site, service, and course must be specified.
Start and end dates must be valid and end must be after the start.
Duration hours must be numeric and greater than zero.
Group size must be numeric and not less than the number of students entered.
calculations: Calculate shift length from start and end time if not specified.
Calculate duration from shifts and shift length if not specified.
conditions: Show/hide fields based on service contact and destination contact status.
system_behavior: Automatic fill of dropdowns based on previous selections.
Handling of errors and warnings through panels.
JavaScript setup and execution upon events.
exceptions: Error messages displayed for invalid times, dates, and user entry conditions.
